w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: It followed you. The Redactor is here.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💀 The Gavel killed Carlos in 4 rounds. The village mourns.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Spool is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE CALLBACK! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
You lock eyes and don't look away. It falters — then backs off, disengaging. Smart. (Stare Down — it backed down.)
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Big." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "It is today. You dreamed about the cameras. Everyone did. The village is very quiet."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/13/6), with 7 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 29 → 24 · capped · Craft 12 · Talk 15 · Explore 45 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
